02 / A little context

Curiosity starts it.
Building makes it real.

I am drawn to unclear ideas: the kind that arrive as a question, a rough sketch, or a problem nobody has properly named yet. My work moves between artificial intelligence, automation, AI systems, SaaS, full-stack development, and product experimentation.

Usually, the process begins with research and a stubborn hunch. I learn what is needed, build an MVP, break it, debug it, and keep refining until the experiment becomes useful. The point is not to collect technologies; it is to understand enough to make something work.

Right now, I am especially interested in AI agents, autonomous systems, Generative AI, RAG, machine learning, deep learning, and the future of intelligent software.

08 / The long way around

How curiosity became
a direction.

2018—2022

Mechanical curiosity

Before software, my curiosity was mechanical. I spent these years around motorcycles—restoring bikes, trying power upgrades, testing unusual setups, and learning what changes when you take something apart and put it back together with more intent.

2023

A complete reset

Health issues asked me to step away from automobiles. On March 21, I joined an institution to learn programming and began with Java. It did not click, and I stopped. In November, I started again with HTML, then CSS and JavaScript. The first attempt failed; the second changed everything.

2024

Trying everything, chasing something

AI tools became a way to learn faster and experiment more freely. I explored coding tools, React Native basics, Flutter, and software development without a neat map. I was building, curious, and still looking for the work that would hold my attention.

2025

Business, marketing, another pivot

With a college friend, I started Monkfit, an online clothing business. It taught me about products, marketing, and making decisions for real users. Digital marketing later sharpened that lens. The experience was valuable—and made it clear that my deepest curiosity lived elsewhere.

January 2026

One last dance

I made a serious promise to myself: one final, focused attempt. I began with Python and, for the first time, the work felt different. It led me into AI, Generative AI, automation, RAG, and the patient craft of building systems.

2026

Going deeper into AI

I joined a Generative AI course at IIT Madras and learned with the guidance of five mentors. The experience helped turn tool-assisted experimentation into a more structured understanding of Generative AI, automation, RAG, AI agents, machine learning, and deep learning.

Present

Zcloud Digitech

I am building Zcloud Digitech, working on freelance projects, and continuing to experiment with emerging technology. AI, automation, mathematics, physics, and intelligent systems are all part of the current exploration. I am still learning. Still building. Still experimenting. This is only the beginning.
